Edwin Barclay.fact: In 1901, at the age of 19, Edwin wrote a Liberian patriotic song, "The Lone Star Forever". In addition, they fostered future Liberian Ambassador to the U.S., George Arthur Padmore (1915–2005).

Edwin Barclay.question: By 1931, _____ was unable to meet its loan obligations and sought relief from its creditors
Edwin Barclay.fact: The Great Depression severely affected Liberia’s economy, as global rubber prices collapsed. By 1931, Liberia was unable to meet its loan obligations and sought relief from its creditors.
